test_harness_description: Temporary verification panels for Phase 1 seams and later headless units.
test_harness_panel_unavailable_descripti: This panel is registered, but one or more dependencies are not available in the current harness.
test_harness_transport_description: Calls PlatformService.Ping through the app transport context.
test_harness_auth_description: Inspects the session facade and token accessor without exposing token contents.
test_harness_query_description: Inspects TanStack Query state and seeds deterministic fake cache data.
test_harness_values_description: Shows build-time constants emitted from spec/values.yaml.
test_harness_i18n_description: Switches the active Paraglide locale and verifies panel copy updates.
mobile_diagnostics_description: Provider health for the mobile shell. No secrets or memory content.
mobile_diagnostics_unavailable: Diagnostics are disabled by the platform diagnostics surface flag.
test_harness_render_description: Skinned universe background, instanced bodies, and a bloom pass on the WebGPU renderer (WebGL2 fallback). Switch skins live.
test_harness_nebula_description: Many mood colors coexisting and bleeding — a stronger star bleeds wider. Drawn through the real palette seam, exercising the WebGL2 fallback.
test_harness_ui_gallery_description: The full button + primitive catalog across variants, sizes, and states — the surface we tune the 2D design language on.
test_harness_overlay_description: Buttons, a HUD, and a modal floating over the live 3D universe — testing 2D chrome legibility against the moving background.
test_harness_flat_description: A composed screen built entirely from 2D primitives — no 3D — to judge layout, hierarchy, and rhythm on their own.
test_harness_theme_description: Switch a universe preset (Aurora / Ember) — one control drives the 3D skin and the 2D theme together, shown over a universe+UI view and a UI-only view.
test_harness_ui_test_description: The live 3D universe with real product chrome floating over it: drive the emotions present in the field, swap the sky, and see how glass reads against a scene that is actually moving. The 2D language itself lives on the design showcase at /design.
test_harness_star_shape_description: One star per emotion, and a candidate look to try on all of them at once. Pick a shape and the whole field takes it, with size and brightness held equal so form and feeling are the only things changing. Drag to tumble, wheel to fly in.
test_harness_star_shape_orb_description: A seed-born light with a softly weathered surface.
test_harness_star_shape_facet_descriptio: Twenty quiet facets, as though a small moon were cut by hand.
test_harness_star_shape_prism_descriptio: Twelve jewel faces carry a wandering veil of color.
test_harness_star_shape_geode_descriptio: A rough crystal shell with dawn glowing through its seams.
test_harness_star_shape_bubble_descripti: A tender, breathing skin of light with an airy heart.
test_harness_star_shape_spire_descriptio: Eight crystalline rays turn slowly toward their own north.
test_harness_star_shape_urchin_descripti: A hushed core wrapped in bright, protective thorns.
test_harness_star_shape_plasma_descripti: Warm currents fold and unfurl across a living surface.
test_harness_star_shape_contour_descript: A softly moving world traced with the contours of remembrance.
test_harness_star_shape_haze_description: A wavering breath of light, almost without an edge.
universe_nebula_notice_body: This color is the emotions you return to — not the average of what you felt, but the memories you reopen, bled into light.

test_harness_sky_description: A shader-lit sphere wrapping the star scene — drag to look around inside it. Twelve skies, each a different arrangement of domain, field, emotion partition and finish; every colour comes from the universe's own feelings. Hand any sky any number of emotions — more feelings means smaller territories, never a muddier wash.

demo_beat_diary_appears: A diary from someone's ordinary week. Read it, then let it split.
demo_beat_split: One entry holds several scenes. Split it and see what it was made of.
demo_beat_launch: Send them up. Each scene becomes a star, and the things it was about become the points it hangs from.
demo_beat_neuron_reuse: Add two more entries. Where they share something — a person, a place, an idea — they hang from the same point, and a shape appears that nobody drew.
demo_beat_time_accelerates: Now push time forward. What isn't returned to dims, and starts losing words.
demo_beat_recall: Remember one. It brightens, and comes back a little changed.
demo_beat_gist_rise: Push time further. Some memories keep only their meaning, and rise.
demo_beat_color: The sky takes its colour from the feelings you return to — a mirror of what you re-read, not an average of everything you wrote.
demo_beat_ornament_taster: Try the place on: the sky behind, the shape a memory takes, the colour a feeling gets.
demo_beat_signup_cta: This universe was made up. Yours would start empty, and be written a day at a time.
demo_theory_note: Inspired by engram theory. What you see is a way of looking, not the brain's own coordinates.
